Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ə.ɣuˈis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [e.ɣoˈis.ta]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

egoista m or f (masculine and feminine plural egoistes)

  1. selfish

Noun

[edit]

egoista m or f by sense (plural egoistes)

  1. selfish person

Related terms

[edit]
  • egoisme

Further reading

[edit]
  • “egoista”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

Esperanto

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /eɡoˈista/
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: e‧go‧is‧ta
  • Hyphenation: ego‧ista

Adjective

[edit]

egoista (accusative singular egoistan, plural egoistaj, accusative plural egoistajn)

  1. egoistic; selfish
    • Roman Frenkel, "Ankaŭ":
      Ankaŭ en mond' egoista
      Troviĝas la kor', kiu amas;
      Ankaŭ dum hor' de l' mizero
      Konsolas esper', kiu flamas.
      Even in a selfish world
      the heart can be found that loves;
      Even in an hour of misery
      burning hope consoles.

Finnish

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

egoista

  1. elative plural of ego

Hungarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From German Egoist, from French égoïste.[1] With the suffix -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈɛɡojiʃtɒ]
  • Hyphenation: ego‧is‧ta
  • Rhymes: -tɒ

Adjective

[edit]

egoista (comparative egoistább, superlative legegoistább)

  1. egoistic
    Synonyms: önző, haszonleső
    Antonyms: önzetlen, altruista

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From ego- +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /e.ɡoˈis.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Hyphenation: e‧go‧ì‧sta
  • Audio:(file)

Adjective

[edit]

egoista m or f by sense (masculine plural egoisti, feminine plural egoiste)

  1. selfish
    Synonym: egoistico

Noun

[edit]

egoista m or f by sense (masculine plural egoisti, feminine plural egoiste)

  1. selfish, egoist
    Antonym: altruista

Related terms

[edit]
  • egoismo

Anagrams

[edit]
  • esagito, esagitò

[edit]

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]

Noun

egoista

Polish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism; compare English egoist, French égoïste, German Egoist, ultimately from Latin ego + -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɛ.ɡɔˈis.ta/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: e‧go‧is‧ta

Noun

[edit]

egoista m pers (female equivalent egoistka)

  1. egoist, self-seeker
    Synonyms: samolub, sobek
    Antonym: altruista

Declension

[edit]
Declension of egoista
singular plural
nominative egoista egoiści/egoisty (deprecative)
genitive egoisty egoistów
dative egoiście egoistom
accusative egoistę egoistów
instrumental egoistą egoistami
locative egoiście egoistach
vocative egoisto egoiści

[edit]
adjective
  • egoistyczny

Related terms

[edit]
adverb
  • egoistycznie
noun
  • egoizm

[edit]
